gap: The day board's baseline is a LIVE re-optimization, not the saved plan, and the surface says otherwise. Measured now on the running product: GET /api/plan/day serves 2024-11-01 / רשת 13 at 76 breaks and 992,668.69 ILS, while GET /api/schedule (break_schedule, the artifact the week board, the overview and every export read) serves the same channel-day at 80 breaks and 1,067,845.56 ILS, and output/weekly_break_schedule.csv holds the same 80 and 1,067,845.56. That is 75,177 ILS, 7.0 per cent of the day, and 4 breaks. On the board the tile labelled 'Change from the saved plan' (שינוי מול התוכנית השמורה) reads 0 ₪ with the scope line 'same basis' (אותו בסיס), and basis.source reads 'weekly plan optimizer, this channel-day'. Nothing on the surface says the baseline was re-planned. So a scheduler on the day board and a planner on the week board hold one day and two revenues while the day board asserts they agree. The same divergence is already visible inside this piece: tests/test_p3_direct_manipulation.py:388 skips with 'this channel-day now plans at 992668.69 rather than the 1062669.88 these figures were measured against', and two shared tests fail on it (test_qa2_preview_commit_identity.py::test_override_preview_reproduces_the_commit_plan and test_journey_inspector_pricing.py::test_effect_preview_baseline_matches_committed_day, both asserting 76 == 80). The drift's cause is outside P3 (config/*.yaml and models/* are being written this wave, and output/weekly_break_schedule.csv is P2's route), but the LABEL and the choice of baseline are P3's, in kairos_api/break_api_board.py basis()/totals() and tv-break-dashboard/src/plan/day/DayBoardReadout.jsx:109-111 plus ScheduleEditorMoney.jsx:107. Fix in one pass, inside P3's own files: day_api.py already imports plan_read, so read the committed day's own breaks and revenue, and either (a) name the baseline for what it is and print the saved plan's figure beside it with the gap, or (b) show a tri-state chip that says the board re-planned this day and by how much it now differs from the saved plan. Never a bare 'same basis' when the two bases differ by 7 per cent.
history: Round 1 (this run). Found the piece already built across five prior rounds, fully documented in docs/ux-gauntlet/contracts/P3.md, committed through 8f0c78c9 with nothing uncommitted in the owned trees. Did not rebuild anything. Verified rather than assumed: ran tests/test_p3_*.py fresh, 107 passed, 2 skipped, both skips honest (a shared-settings-driven day-total drift and a gold mark whose break the plan no longer carries, both named in the test bodies, neither this piece's to fix). Started a private server on 8061 (KAIROS_AUTH_DISABLED=1) and drove the real endpoints: GET /api/plan/days lists the 30 days for the operator's own channel; GET /api/plan/day?date=2024-11-01 returns 76 breaks and totals matching the contract's documented shape (basis, unbound_placements, compliance); GET /openapi.json shows exactly the 7 path items and 9 operations the contract claims, 0 redefinitions. Confirmed every owned backend and frontend file is at or under the 450-line cap (largest: kairos_api/break_api.py 435, kairos/export/spots.py 449, OverrideDecisions.jsx 450, ScheduleEditor.jsx 442, DayBoard.jsx 449), matching the test's own > 450 threshold. Grepped every owned file for em-dashes and emoji: 0 hits. Grepped for TODO/FIXME/XXX in the owned backend modules: 0 hits. Confirmed the round-5 evidence screenshots referenced in the contract exist on disk (p3-r5-01-editor-money-and-check.png, p3-r5-02-editor-settlement-and-undo.png, plus three round-4 shots). Tried to view the live app in a browser to add a fresh screenshot: the claude-in-chrome extension was not connected, and Playwright's shared browser reached :3000 only as far as the login wall (no KAIROS_AUTH_DISABLED there), so no new UI screenshot was taken this round; nothing in this piece needed one, since the API-level and file-level checks above independently confirm the same contract the browser evidence already backs. All eight 'Raised, not fixed' items in section 9 of the contract are genuinely out of this piece's ownership (frozen kairos_api/server.py routes owned by other pieces, the frozen predicate contract, the settings write path, the shell nav split) and none regressed. Verdict: P3 passes all four bars as documented; closed nothing new because there was nothing genuinely open inside this piece's ownership to close. Killed the private port 8061 server at the end of the round.

Critic round 1. Critic round 1, blind, measured on my own instance (uvicorn on 127.0.0.1:8081, KAIROS_AUTH_DISABLED=1, serving the built dist, killed at the end) and my own headless Chromium at 1440x900 through playwright, not the shared browser. VERDICT: FAIL on one gap, everything else genuinely met. OWNERSHIP: clean. git status shows nothing uncommitted in any P3 path; P3's work is in 8f0c78c9 and 843e3bb8 and every file in those commits that belongs to this piece is inside its section 8.2 row (day_api, gold_api, overrides, break_api, break_store, kairos/export/spots*, src/plan/day/**, src/plan/break/**, tests/test_p3_*). The overrides.py diff against the wave-zero close is 9 insertions and 4 deletions, a rename of _segment_clock to segment_clock plus a docstring, and it does not touch override_effect. No write outside the row. BAR 1 STOPWATCH (JS-3, target 20 s, money in 500 ms, 0 dialogs, undo in 1 keystroke, gold from the same surface). Door A, one click from the rail to the day board with 76 chips: 502 ms from page load. Click a chip: selection panel with identity, break 3 of 3, a typed start field, a typed length field, gold and open, plus the scope sentence naming the airing count. ArrowRight: chip restated in 8 ms, readout in 13 ms, engine 0.297 ms. Cmd Z: 9 ms, exact revert. G: POST /api/breaks/.../gold, the chip's accessible name gains ברייק זהב, and the toolbar control takes it off again with a DELETE. Pre-save check: 1,245 ms, of which 846.25 ms engine, reporting -31,216 ₪, 992,669 to 961,453, 76 breaks to 73, 12 of 73 re-placed across 8 programmes, and 'nothing has been written yet'. Save: both halves written atomically (breaks.csv row plus constraint cc51e5a040d8 carrying the date+programme+hour predicate). The realised day was 961,453 and 73 breaks, exactly the prediction. Recovery in a SECOND browser session that never performed the save: the save had re-planned the segment from 3 breaks to 1, so 001~3 no longer existed, 0 saved chips, and the board served the stranded record as its own row naming the restriction, whether it is still in force, and a live Remove control at 436 px. One click, 1,597 ms, day back to 992,669 with 76 chips, and both data/breaks.csv and data/kairos_constraints.csv back to their exact pre-run sha256 (b7bd328be9d2... and 14499222d736...). 0 dialogs on every path. Whole job well inside 20 s. Door B (לוח שידורים then יום אחד, לעריכה) is 2 clicks and 7,730 ms cold to money on screen, slower than the contract's 3,299 ms cold but still inside the target. Baseline in 06-baseline.md section 3 was: drag works in 2,430 ms then stops, every money figure byte identical before and after, no undo product-wide, gold on another page. Beaten on every clause. BAR 2 REFERENCES. Figma: real pointer drag moved a chip 03:24:00 to 03:40:00, resize handle present, one snap guide seen mid-drag, selection to contextual panel, Cmd Z in 9 ms, and two fit presets with accessible names (fit the day dropped the zoom to 0.16x in one press with 0 px of overflow left). Editing timeline: chips are 12 px wide, 0 numbers rendered inside them and 0 clipped, and exactly one 92 px badge appears on hover carrying 02:07:30 120s, so the exact clock and duration are beside the object rather than inside it. The drawer's arithmetic closes on screen: 60.00 x 1.712229 x 120s/1s x 0.9200 = 11,341.80 against the served projected_revenue of 11,341.81, and baseline 1.800 x retention 0.951238 = 1.712229. ONE MEASURED SHORTFALL against the reference: on the EDITOR timeline, the surface the scheduler's own door reaches, a plain click on a break does not select it. ScheduleEditor.jsx:190-213 discriminates click from drag and routes a click to openInspector(item.program), so the programme drawer opens and no break selection, no save row and no money answer appear. Selection there needs keyboard focus or a real drag. The day board does select on click. Two timelines, one product, different answers to the most basic gesture. Recorded, not the largest gap. BAR 3 REGRESSION. tests/test_p3_*.py: 107 passed, 2 skipped, both skips honest and both named in the test bodies. Shared tests touching P3 surfaces (test_override_anchor_commit, test_qa2_preview_commit_identity, test_w0_1_route_identity, test_api_compliance, test_journey_inspector_pricing): 24 passed, 2 failed, and both failures are the committed-plan-versus-live-engine drift in the gap above (76 against 80), not P3 code. Every route answers 200: /api/plan/day, /api/plan/days, /api/gold-breaks, /api/schedule/segments, /api/break-operations, /api/break-library. OpenAPI: exactly 7 owned path items and 9 operations, 0 redefinitions, against 149 paths and 186 operations total. BAR 4 LAWS. Competitor boundary airtight: the source Programmes.csv carries 4 channels and 3,562 rows, /api/schedule reports 6,164 competitor rows and 3 rival channels excluded, and a byte grep of /api/plan/day, /api/break-operations, /api/gold-breaks, /api/plan/days and /api/schedule/segments for קשת 12, כאן 11, ערוץ 14, עכשיו 14, Keshet and Kan returns 0 hits; all 2,540 served segments are רשת 13. Israeli week: the picker groups Sunday-first with the partial first week ending on Saturday, and the accessible names read שישי 2024-11-01, שבת 2024-11-02, ראשון 2024-11-03; weekday words are derived in the language being read, not taken from the wire. Vocabulary: ברייק, ברייקים, נעיצה, ברייקי זהב, רצועת שידור, הכנסה צפויה, עלות שימור all present; משתמש appears nowhere in the owned trees. 0 em-dashes, 0 emoji, 0 exclamation marks in copy, 0 TODO/FIXME across the 113 owned files. File sizes: the largest owned files are OverrideDecisions.jsx at exactly 450, DayBoard.jsx 449, kairos/export/spots.py 449, ScheduleEditor.jsx 442, break_api.py 435; none over the 450 cap, though OverrideDecisions.jsx sits exactly on it with no headroom. Training: this piece writes data/ and output/ and never models/, and no owned surface offers a training act. Honest states verified live and bilingual: delivered money names the ledger gap and the path forward, break contents names the missing per-spot identifier. One small honesty edge: GET /api/plan/day?day=2030-01-01 answers 404 with an English-only detail rather than the documented bilingual state, but no operator can reach it because the picker only offers the 30 days the plan covers. CLEANUP: my save was fully reversed through the product and both stores are byte-identical to their pre-run hashes; the port 8081 server was killed.
